title_zh: 询问成瘾支持服务的首次联系办法

scenario.goal_zh: 了解支持机构的联络方式及费用援助咨询渠道，并确定首次联系的下一步

context_zh: 虚构沟通练习中，费伊向社区服务接待员询问成瘾支持的联络信息，不讨论个人诊断或治疗方案。
author: author-phase06-c

sentences.speaker: Faye
sentences.text: I am looking for someone to talk to about addiction. Is this the right desk?

sentences.speaker: Receptionist Owen
sentences.text: I can give you the contact details for the local support agency. Their adviser can explain what they offer.

sentences.speaker: Faye
sentences.text: I am also worried about the cost. Is there any financial aid?

sentences.speaker: Receptionist Owen
sentences.text: I do not know which arrangements would apply to you. The adviser can answer that before you book anything.

sentences.speaker: Faye
sentences.text: Could I have their number on paper? I would rather call from home.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist Owen
sentences.text: Certainly. Here it is, with the opening hours.

sentences.speaker: Faye
sentences.text: Thank you. I will call and ask about an initial conversation and the costs.
